textual.observation: The narration promotes a OneCoin bonus opportunity by linking a specific high-income outcome to joining and sharing the project.

evidence.quote: This project offers a unique bonus plan, and it took only twelve months for 400 people to earn 35,000 euros a week.
On average, we have 4,000 new active members a day who join us, and share this huge opportunity.

textual.context: Presented as a first-person promotional claim about OneCoin membership and growth.
textual.potential_relevance: A concrete income claim is directly paired with joining and sharing the project, creating a reward-for-participation relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the stated earnings, membership counts, or bonus terms are accurate or were received by the named participants.

textual.observation: The source describes monetary returns for recommending others and building a people structure, alongside income from trading OneCoin.

evidence.quote: Money for recommendation. It means for building the structure of people and money from the one coin coin itself you can trade the currency in the Internal Exchange

textual.context: Presented as an explanation of the OneCoin income model within a promotional pitch.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised monetary benefit is linked to recommending people and building a network, with a separate trading-related income stream.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether recruitment was required, whether payments occurred, or how the trading process operated.

textual.observation: Viewers are instructed to click an earnings-related button, submit their name and email, and register as a partner to receive manuals and a wealth code.

fill in your name and email and we will send you the video manuals
you will immediately become our partner and you will get your own wealth code

textual.context: Presented as a direct promotional registration flow; the speaker does not explain who receives or stores the submitted information.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised earning opportunity is linked to clicking, providing contact information, and registering as a partner.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish what happens to the submitted information, whether registration was free in practice, or whether the promised materials or wealth code were provided.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin through unusually high reported earnings, referral-based income, and claims of substantial past and continuing currency growth. It directs viewers to click an earnings button, provide their name and email, become partners, and receive a wealth code and instructional materials, although the accuracy of the claims, handling of submitted data, and any resulting transaction or benefit are not established.
